stem:
Dhruvil looks at a number line from $2000$ to $3000$. The interval is divided into five equal parts with marks at equal spacing.

What number does the first mark after $2000$ show?

options.text: $2001$, treating each mark as one unit.
$2500$, splitting the interval into two equal halves only.
$3000$, jumping straight to the right endpoint.

teacher.key_rationale: The span 1000 is split into five equal parts, so each step is 200. The first mark after 2000 is 2200.
